core.title: Closed-loop photoreactor design enabled by machine learning and digital twins
core.abstract: Abstract Designing efficient photoreactors remains challenging due to the complex interplay of reflection, scattering, and absorption. Here, we introduce a closed-loop workflow integrating ray-tracing digital twins with multi-objective Bayesian optimization to design photoreactors with high photon capture and uniform irradiation. A digital 3D reactor model is calibrated using measured emission characteristics, reflectivity data, and geometrical properties and validated against potassium ferrioxalate actinometry. The validated model explores reflector shape and vial positioning, identifying geometries that maximize incident photon flux while maintaining homogeneity across 16 vials. Experimental validation using a photocatalytic Suzuki–Miyaura cross-coupling shows that reaction yields track simulated photon flux. The optimized reactor is further applied to quantum-yield screening, enabling mechanistic insights across diverse conditions in a single experiment. This work establishes an experimentally validated virtual co-design framework in which machine learning and digital twins accelerate photoreactor development and support quantitative understanding of photochemical processes.
core.summary: 光反应器的反射、散射与吸收相互耦合，使几何设计难以凭直觉优化。本文将经实验校准的光线追踪数字孪生与多目标贝叶斯优化结合，联合调整反射器形状和样品瓶位置，兼顾16瓶光子通量与辐照均匀性[P2—P4]。作者通过光量计及光子受限交叉偶联实验检验预测，并利用逐瓶吸收校正开展量子产率筛选[P5—P7]。其价值主要在于减少实体试制、连接结构寻优与定量化学表征；新系统仍须重新验证，不能直接等同于智能运维成果[P8]。

core.method: 基于原文摘要的规则摘要
core.recommendation: 建议作为数字孪生辅助结构优化的方法迁移文献重点阅读，尤其关注实验校准、多目标寻优和逐瓶光学校正；若仅筛选智能运维直接成果，则不宜优先推荐[P3—P8]。

deep_read.problem: 研究问题是如何在复杂光传输条件下，同时提高多瓶反应器的光子捕获与辐照一致性。反射器曲率、样品位置、光源发射及材料反射性质共同影响结果，传统设计需要反复打印和表征。作者强调这些权衡不能预先凭直觉判断，因此需要可定量评估的设计流程[P1、P2、P5]。
deep_read.method: 作者以实测光源发射和材料反射率校准COMSOL光线追踪模型，并用草酸铁钾光量计验证。高斯过程代理模型以总入射光子通量及最小、最大瓶通量之比为双目标，经9个拉丁超立方初始样本和56次贝叶斯优化迭代，筛选反射器与瓶位置组合[P3、P4]。
deep_read.innovation: 解读：创新重点不是单独采用机器学习，而是将实验校准、物理模拟、参数化几何搜索和实体检验组成虚拟协同设计流程。优化后的反应器还保留逐瓶光学表征信息，可进一步校正吸收差异并开展量子产率研究，使结构设计与化学解释相衔接[P2、P6、P7]。
deep_read.findings: 独立光量计验证中，模拟每瓶约25 mW，实验约26 mW；代表性设计的数值收敛差异低于3%[P3—P5]。反应器β在光子受限实验中表现最佳，但约10%的实验误差限制细微比较[P6]。量子产率均低于1%，镍用量与溶剂变化揭示了条件限定的化学效应[P7]。
deep_read.limitations: 约10%的实验误差限制反应器间差异判别，均匀性目标改善也较小[P4、P6]。作者要求每个新系统重新验证，不能直接外推至其他光源或材料[P8]。当前未提供补充资料与代码实际内容；逐页记录无原文件缺项，公式乱码已纠正，不构成缺式证据。
deep_read.connection: 解读：与结构设计的联系较强，可借鉴以物理模型替代大量实体试制、同时处理性能权衡的策略。与智能运维和可靠性的联系则是间接的：实验校准与新系统验证具有方法启发，但本文没有故障诊断、退化预测、维护决策或长期可靠性测试，不能据数字孪生标签认定直接契合[P4、P8]。
deep_read.next_steps: 建议：迁移时先明确目标设备的可测性能和模型校准条件，再比较模拟寻优与实体基线，并检验测量误差是否足以区分候选方案。若面向智能运维，可另行引入退化状态、在线观测和维护目标，检验模型更新后的决策效果；这些属于新增研究，并非作者已验证结论[P6、P8]。

core.summary: 论文提出IGD框架，将自然语言需求转化为零件设计、CAD代码、装配及运动学分析。系统通过知识检索、专用智能体、蚁群启发调度和建模检查反馈连接设计环节。[P2、P13—P15] 作者报告检查器提升几何重建精度，并展示减速器改型、起落架和抽油机案例。[P4—P11] 其价值主要在概念到几何阶段的自动化，尚不包含完整制造、公差及多物理场验证，不能等同于生产就绪或可靠性认证。[P12]

deep_read.problem: 机械设计不仅需要理解功能需求，还必须处理尺寸、空间配合、任务依赖及机构运动。论文针对通用LLM缺乏工程约束意识、专用网络任务覆盖狭窄的问题，研究如何把语言意图转化为可执行且机械一致的多阶段流程，而非仅生成外观模型。[P1—P2]
deep_read.method: IGD由TP规划、PD设计、PM建模及PA装配智能体协作。ACBAC用信息素共享记忆协调任务；PM结合CRP参考检索、CGP微调生成与检查器反馈；PA通过GART检索装配子图，并以位姿优化约束装配一致性。[P2、P13—P15]
deep_read.innovation: 解读：创新重点是工程知识与执行流程的系统整合，而非提出全新的语言模型。框架将共享记忆调度、互补建模提示、装配关系迁移和运动学分析串联，使语言生成受到几何与关系先验约束；但现有资料不足以证明各模块贡献均被独立隔离验证。[P8、P11—P15]
deep_read.findings: 作者报告无检查器至GPT-4o检查配置的IoU由0.55升至0.92，CD由0.85降至0.12；1000个样本均在10轮以内满足自动验收。三项装配任务中所提方法准确率均为100%，但跨模型、跨任务结果并非全部满分，不能外推为普遍可靠。[P4—P6]
deep_read.limitations: 作者明确尚未纳入详细DFM、完整公差链及耦合多物理场仿真；知识库覆盖、大规模装配和全新设计仍受限。装配误差阈值在所供笔记中无具体数值，部分模型和部署组件不公开。核对记录未确认原文件缺项，公式乱码均属已纠正的提取错误。[P12、P15]
deep_read.connection: 解读：对结构设计，价值在于把需求变化快速落实为可执行CAD改型；对智能运维，可作为故障工况到设计调整的潜在接口。可靠性研究则需区分几何、运动学一致与承载安全：文中尺寸强化案例并未提供疲劳寿命或可靠性指标验证。[P9—P12]
deep_read.next_steps: 建议：选取具有明确载荷与失效模式的减速器任务，将生成几何接入应力、疲劳和公差分析，以安全裕度作为独立验收条件；固定模型与预算，对比检索、检查器和信息素调度的消融效果，同时报告失败类型与成本。这是后续研究设想，并非作者已验证成果。[P12—P15]

core.title: Inverse design of stochastic, voxelated thermo-viscoelastic digital materials
core.abstract: Abstract Polymer material jetting enables the fabrication of voxelated, multi-material structures with material control at the microscale. However, current work often neglects viscoelastic effects and designing voxelated digital materials remains challenging due to the complexity of the vast design freedom and intractability of efficiently modeling macroscale voxel structures. We present an efficient representation of stochastically mixed, voxelated digital materials and develop a generalized viscoelastic temperature-dependent material model to design and simulate digital materials mixed from two constituent polymers. The material model is based on an extended percolation theory considering frequency and temperature. An artificial neural network is trained on the material model to directly estimate target material behavior given arbitrary non-linear, user requirements. The approach is validated using two case studies requiring tailored, non-linear material behavior: a personalized wrist orthosis and a machine damper. These show the newly unlocked possibilities for the design and fabrication of tuned, stochastic digital materials.
core.summary: 如何让同一打印结构既抵抗瞬时冲击，又能长期柔顺变形？本文将随机混合体素材料表示为介观粗网格，以温度、频率相关渗流模型描述两种聚合物的黏弹性，再通过神经网络从性能需求反推混合比例。[P2–P4]阻尼器与腕部矫形器展示了滞回预测及分区选材能力，但阻尼器高频误差上升，矫形器冲击仅经模拟验证。[P5–P6]其价值在于连接材料配比、跨时间尺度响应与结构仿真，而非证明任意材料泛化或临床有效性。

deep_read.innovation: 方法特色是把介观材料表示、扩展渗流关系与逆向选材串成统一流程，而非直接优化每个体素。渗流系数随温度和频率变化，使混合规律能够描述不同响应区间。[P3–P4]解读：其创新重心是材料行为的任务独立参数化，不是新增几何生成算法或实测训练大数据库。

core.title: Machine learning-enabled inverse design of bioinspired layered composite structures with maximum auxetic performance
core.abstract: Abstract Layered composite structures inspired by biological tissues can exhibit out-of-plane negative Poisson’s ratio, but identifying layups that maximize auxetic performance is challenging in high-dimensional designs. Here, we introduce an inverse design framework that searches for laminate layups with minimum Poisson’s ratio. The approach combines multi-start resampling with machine learning–guided clustering to map layup families across layer numbers. Analytical relations from laminate mechanics link ply angles to effective properties, and computer simulations with laboratory measurements validate the predicted minima. The analysis resolves three layup categories, explains how shear-strain mismatch across bonded plies drives through-thickness auxetic expansion, and shows that simple symmetry rules reduce the search space. The framework reproduces previously reported minima and uncovers layups that approach lower Poisson’s ratios under practical constraints. These results provide a physics-grounded, data-efficient route to engineer layered composite structures with strong auxetic responses and offer concise design rules for impact mitigation, vibration control, and flexible structures.

core.title: 4D printed deformation labels with machine learning for monitoring and preservation of respiring climacteric fruits
core.abstract: Abstract 4D printed labels that change color and shape were developed to achieve the dual functions of quality assessment and maintenance of respiring climacteric fruits. The effect of addition of essential oil emulsion and different geometric structures on deformation as well as the corresponding mechanisms were explored. Cast, 3D printed, and 4D printed labels were compared based on their responses to fruit quality and compatibility with machine learning. The addition of emulsion significantly affected the degree of deformation by altering the printing fidelity, hydrophilicity, and flexibility of the network structure. Geometric designs (Including printing layers, filament intersection angles, and infill ratios) changed both the direction and degree of deformation. Unlike cast and 3D printed labels, 4D printed labels simultaneously changed color and shape in response to variations in humidity and carbon dioxide levels in the package, enabling more accurate visual monitoring the turning points of fruit quality. The MobileNet model achieved recognition accuracy of 97% for 4D printed labels, which played an active role in achieving intelligent warnings. Additionally, deformation along with microstructure destruction positively impacted the controlled release of essential oils through a non-Fickian mechanism, resulting in a better preservation effect.

papers.title: Closed-loop photoreactor design enabled by machine learning and digital twins
papers.abstract: Abstract Designing efficient photoreactors remains challenging due to the complex interplay of reflection, scattering, and absorption. Here, we introduce a closed-loop workflow integrating ray-tracing digital twins with multi-objective Bayesian optimization to design photoreactors with high photon capture and uniform irradiation. A digital 3D reactor model is calibrated using measured emission characteristics, reflectivity data, and geometrical properties and validated against potassium ferrioxalate actinometry. The validated model explores reflector shape and vial positioning, identifying geometries that maximize incident photon flux while maintaining homogeneity across 16 vials. Experimental validation using a photocatalytic Suzuki–Miyaura cross-coupling shows that reaction yields track simulated photon flux. The optimized reactor is further applied to quantum-yield screening, enabling mechanistic insights across diverse conditions in a single experiment. This work establishes an experimentally validated virtual co-design framework in which machine learning and digital twins accelerate photoreactor development and support quantitative understanding of photochemical processes.
papers.summary: 光反应器的反射、散射与吸收相互耦合，使几何设计难以凭直觉优化。本文将经实验校准的光线追踪数字孪生与多目标贝叶斯优化结合，联合调整反射器形状和样品瓶位置，兼顾16瓶光子通量与辐照均匀性[P2—P4]。作者通过光量计及光子受限交叉偶联实验检验预测，并利用逐瓶吸收校正开展量子产率筛选[P5—P7]。其价值主要在于减少实体试制、连接结构寻优与定量化学表征；新系统仍须重新验证，不能直接等同于智能运维成果[P8]。

deep_read.problem: 研究问题是如何在复杂光传输条件下，同时提高多瓶反应器的光子捕获与辐照一致性。反射器曲率、样品位置、光源发射及材料反射性质共同影响结果，传统设计需要反复打印和表征。作者强调这些权衡不能预先凭直觉判断，因此需要可定量评估的设计流程[P1、P2、P5]。
deep_read.method: 作者以实测光源发射和材料反射率校准COMSOL光线追踪模型，并用草酸铁钾光量计验证。高斯过程代理模型以总入射光子通量及最小、最大瓶通量之比为双目标，经9个拉丁超立方初始样本和56次贝叶斯优化迭代，筛选反射器与瓶位置组合[P3、P4]。
deep_read.innovation: 解读：创新重点不是单独采用机器学习，而是将实验校准、物理模拟、参数化几何搜索和实体检验组成虚拟协同设计流程。优化后的反应器还保留逐瓶光学表征信息，可进一步校正吸收差异并开展量子产率研究，使结构设计与化学解释相衔接[P2、P6、P7]。
deep_read.findings: 独立光量计验证中，模拟每瓶约25 mW，实验约26 mW；代表性设计的数值收敛差异低于3%[P3—P5]。反应器β在光子受限实验中表现最佳，但约10%的实验误差限制细微比较[P6]。量子产率均低于1%，镍用量与溶剂变化揭示了条件限定的化学效应[P7]。
deep_read.limitations: 约10%的实验误差限制反应器间差异判别，均匀性目标改善也较小[P4、P6]。作者要求每个新系统重新验证，不能直接外推至其他光源或材料[P8]。当前未提供补充资料与代码实际内容；逐页记录无原文件缺项，公式乱码已纠正，不构成缺式证据。
deep_read.connection: 解读：与结构设计的联系较强，可借鉴以物理模型替代大量实体试制、同时处理性能权衡的策略。与智能运维和可靠性的联系则是间接的：实验校准与新系统验证具有方法启发，但本文没有故障诊断、退化预测、维护决策或长期可靠性测试，不能据数字孪生标签认定直接契合[P4、P8]。
deep_read.next_steps: 建议：迁移时先明确目标设备的可测性能和模型校准条件，再比较模拟寻优与实体基线，并检验测量误差是否足以区分候选方案。若面向智能运维，可另行引入退化状态、在线观测和维护目标，检验模型更新后的决策效果；这些属于新增研究，并非作者已验证结论[P6、P8]。

papers.summary: 本文针对路径型MEMS设计中拓扑自由度与制造可行性的矛盾，将连通性、线宽及间距约束嵌入几何生成过程，以44维变量联合控制路径组织和局部线宽，再用形貌图像代理加速进化搜索。[P3–P8]微加热器红外实验显示，温度变异系数由4.04%降至1.22%；微弹簧有限元验证显示位移增加、峰值应力降低。[P12–P14]核心阅读价值在于制造约束下的结构表示，而非通用生成模型；机械实验、寿命改善及任意三维几何适用性尚无证据。

deep_read.problem: 路径型MEMS的响应受连通路径、空间部署和局部截面共同支配。固定模板限制组织变化，像素化自由设计又可能产生断连和不可制造细节。[P2–P3]作者进一步指出，规则几何覆盖不必然带来均匀温度场，设计需要补偿边界与支撑区域的不均匀散热。[P5]
deep_read.method: 固定边界后，以32维拓扑变量和12维线宽变量驱动生成：先筛除不可行走向，再评分选取节点，并以三次B样条调制线宽。[P5–P6]布局经DXF进入有限元，同时栅格化训练ResNet-18；热学使用分层GA，机械使用约束NSGA-II搜索。[P14–P16]
deep_read.innovation: 作者将贡献定位于几何表示：制造规则内置于连续变量到离散布局的映射，而非依靠优化后修补。[P3、P14]另一关键是双表示分工，潜变量保障可搜索性，实例化形貌图像提供预测所需空间信息。解读：创新不在单独采用CNN或进化算法，而在二者与约束生成器的接口。
deep_read.findings: 热学有限元中TCV约由0.85%降至0.19%，等温面积比由41.47%升至99.79%；红外实验对应指标为4.04%至1.22%、34.7%至95.6%。[P10、P12]机械有限元显示位移389.56至508.91 μm，峰值应力1841.9至1541.3 MPa，支持跨物理目标迁移。[P14]
deep_read.limitations: 适用范围限于路径型MEMS，任意自由形状、非连通及完全三维几何不在当前实现范围。[P15]机械案例仅有有限元验证；热学实测均温不同，指标相对各自均温计算，不能称严格同温实验。[P14]核对记录未报告原文件缺项，提取乱码已纠正；亦无寿命改善的直接证据。
deep_read.connection: 解读：与结构设计的联系最直接，可将连通梁、悬簧和加热路径的制造条件转为生成先验。[P2–P6]与可靠性的联系在于提供热点、应力集中相关性能的优化入口，但这些指标不能替代失效概率或疲劳寿命。智能运维方面仅具方法迁移启发，论文未验证在线监测、诊断或维护决策。
deep_read.next_steps: 建议：先在目标器件上重建边界条件和制造规则，复核代理误差，再比较同温与同功耗工况，避免混淆均匀性和节能。[P10、P16]若面向可靠性，应补充工艺扰动下的性能分布及寿命试验；主动采样与不确定性感知可参考作者展望，但应作为待验证扩展，而非已有能力。[P15]

papers.title: Inverse design of stochastic, voxelated thermo-viscoelastic digital materials
papers.abstract: Abstract Polymer material jetting enables the fabrication of voxelated, multi-material structures with material control at the microscale. However, current work often neglects viscoelastic effects and designing voxelated digital materials remains challenging due to the complexity of the vast design freedom and intractability of efficiently modeling macroscale voxel structures. We present an efficient representation of stochastically mixed, voxelated digital materials and develop a generalized viscoelastic temperature-dependent material model to design and simulate digital materials mixed from two constituent polymers. The material model is based on an extended percolation theory considering frequency and temperature. An artificial neural network is trained on the material model to directly estimate target material behavior given arbitrary non-linear, user requirements. The approach is validated using two case studies requiring tailored, non-linear material behavior: a personalized wrist orthosis and a machine damper. These show the newly unlocked possibilities for the design and fabrication of tuned, stochastic digital materials.
papers.summary: 如何让同一打印结构既抵抗瞬时冲击，又能长期柔顺变形？本文将随机混合体素材料表示为介观粗网格，以温度、频率相关渗流模型描述两种聚合物的黏弹性，再通过神经网络从性能需求反推混合比例。[P2–P4]阻尼器与腕部矫形器展示了滞回预测及分区选材能力，但阻尼器高频误差上升，矫形器冲击仅经模拟验证。[P5–P6]其价值在于连接材料配比、跨时间尺度响应与结构仿真，而非证明任意材料泛化或临床有效性。

papers.title: Machine learning-enabled inverse design of bioinspired layered composite structures with maximum auxetic performance
papers.abstract: Abstract Layered composite structures inspired by biological tissues can exhibit out-of-plane negative Poisson’s ratio, but identifying layups that maximize auxetic performance is challenging in high-dimensional designs. Here, we introduce an inverse design framework that searches for laminate layups with minimum Poisson’s ratio. The approach combines multi-start resampling with machine learning–guided clustering to map layup families across layer numbers. Analytical relations from laminate mechanics link ply angles to effective properties, and computer simulations with laboratory measurements validate the predicted minima. The analysis resolves three layup categories, explains how shear-strain mismatch across bonded plies drives through-thickness auxetic expansion, and shows that simple symmetry rules reduce the search space. The framework reproduces previously reported minima and uncovers layups that approach lower Poisson’s ratios under practical constraints. These results provide a physics-grounded, data-efficient route to engineer layered composite structures with strong auxetic responses and offer concise design rules for impact mitigation, vibration control, and flexible structures.

deep_read.method: 研究以层合力学显式计算角度对应的泊松比，采用距离平方加权重采样选择初始点，再以BFGS开展局部搜索。[P3][P5] 各层数保留最低泊松比的十个铺层，通过对称性、角度数量等特征实施层次聚类，并将所得规则用于高维搜索降维。[P6]

papers.title: 4D printed deformation labels with machine learning for monitoring and preservation of respiring climacteric fruits
papers.abstract: Abstract 4D printed labels that change color and shape were developed to achieve the dual functions of quality assessment and maintenance of respiring climacteric fruits. The effect of addition of essential oil emulsion and different geometric structures on deformation as well as the corresponding mechanisms were explored. Cast, 3D printed, and 4D printed labels were compared based on their responses to fruit quality and compatibility with machine learning. The addition of emulsion significantly affected the degree of deformation by altering the printing fidelity, hydrophilicity, and flexibility of the network structure. Geometric designs (Including printing layers, filament intersection angles, and infill ratios) changed both the direction and degree of deformation. Unlike cast and 3D printed labels, 4D printed labels simultaneously changed color and shape in response to variations in humidity and carbon dioxide levels in the package, enabling more accurate visual monitoring the turning points of fruit quality. The MobileNet model achieved recognition accuracy of 97% for 4D printed labels, which played an active role in achieving intelligent warnings. Additionally, deformation along with microstructure destruction positively impacted the controlled release of essential oils through a non-Fickian mechanism, resulting in a better preservation effect.

deep_read.findings: 作者选定10%乳液及单层、30%填充率、60°交叉角方案；该几何方案第10天累计释放量较四层对照高42.32%。[P6][P8]MobileNet最佳，正文报告97.90%，图9计数重算约97.92%。[P10][P12]较高精油释放伴随后期较低菌落总数，支持保鲜优势。[P11]

deep_read.connection: 解读：与智能运维的联系主要是方法迁移，即以环境响应结构提供多维状态信息，再由视觉模型识别状态转折；并非已经验证设备故障预警。[P10][P12]对结构设计与可靠性研究，更直接的启示是响应幅度、网络完整性和功能释放之间存在需要联合优化的权衡。[P4–P9]
